title: Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero
abstract: arXiv:2609.35328v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) is one of the highlights in the recent AI for Optimization trend. This paradigm's bi-level workflow leverages the learnable algorithm design policy at meta level to ensure the performance and generalization improvement on the low-level optimization task. While MetaBBO helps advance the performance lower bound of the resulted optimization system, it is currently handcrafted and customized case by case to adapt different optimization problems, which inevitably introduces inherent subjectivity and hence restricts the performance upper bound and usability in practice. In this paper, we address this issue by regarding MetaBBO's design loop as coding task, where we could introduce openendedness into MetaBBO with recursive self-improvement capability of advanced coding agents. Specifically, we propose a dual-agent framework: i) a task agent continuously refines the codebase of a target MetaBBO approach

translated_title: 超级算法设计智能体：从零开始演化可学习优化器
translated_abstract: 元黑盒优化（MetaBBO）是近年来“AI for Optimization（人工智能助力优化）”趋势中的亮点之一。该范式的双层工作流利用元层面的可学习算法设计策略，以确保底层优化任务在性能和泛化能力上的提升。虽然MetaBBO有助于抬高所得优化系统的性能下限，但目前它需要针对不同的优化问题进行人工逐案手工定制，这不可避免地引入了固有的主观性，从而限制了性能上限以及实际应用中的可用性。在本文中，我们通过将MetaBBO的设计循环视为编码任务来解决这一问题，从而借助先进编码智能体的递归自我改进能力，将开放性引入MetaBBO。具体而言，我们提出了一个双智能体框架：i) 任务智能体持续迭代改进目标MetaBBO方法的代码库……
tldr: 该论文提出将元黑盒优化（MetaBBO）的设计过程建模为编码任务，通过双智能体框架利用先进编码智能体的递归自我改进能力，从零开始自动演化可学习优化器，从而消除人工逐案定制设计所带来的主观性限制。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a dual-agent framework that treats the design loop of Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) as a coding task, leveraging advanced coding agents' recursive self-improvement capability to automatically evolve learnable optimizers from zero, thereby eliminating the inherent subjectivity of handcrafted, case-by-case design.
